Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Hall
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 03/29/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 306 as introduced could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, upon approval of the Legislature, by either $25,000 or $50,000 for each year of wrongfully incarceration of an individual that meets the criteria provided in the bill.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Hall
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 04/07/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 306 as amended and reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, upon approval of the Legislature, by $25,000 for each year of wrongfully incarceration of an individual that meets the criteria provided in the bill.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Sanderford
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 47 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Optometry until October 1, 2025, pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or federal funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
